title: TASK-075 follow-up 75.5: per-run toolkit stamp producer <run>/toolkit.json {commit, dirty, prompt_sha256} so history.py labels new run pairs source/engine (reader already in history.py)
requirement: REQ-0034 Q1 (user 2026-09-30) + RAW-00508 split: pipeline run and scan_batch results record the toolkit stamp as a sidecar; no prompt change; past runs stay unknown
acceptance_criteria: 99.2 toolkit_stamp wrapper validates JSON, a fault never charges an attempt
99.3 pipeline run writes <run>/toolkit.json once at creation, never on resume/rebuild
99.4 single-source result carries .toolkit; unset output byte-identical
$0, frozen prompts hashed not edited, non-git kit does not fail

design.summary: history.py stamp producer; toolkit_stamp wrapper validates; pipeline sidecar <run>/toolkit.json written once in pl_new_run; single-source result .toolkit key; non-git kit gives commit null, never fails

implementation.summary: history.py stamp + prompt_hashes moved from track.py, toolkit_stamp wrapper in scan_common.sh, sidecar in pl_new_run, .toolkit key via finalize_result

unit_test.command: bash tests/toolkit_stamp_test.sh; pipeline_run, pipeline_pool, pipeline_track tests alone; tests/run_all.sh --fast
unit_test.result: toolkit_stamp 22/22 (4 scratch bites fail it); pipeline_run 127/0; pipeline_pool 58/0; pipeline_track 47/0; --fast 162 suites only known track_hook S3 (clean HEAD too)

security.result: deterministic stamp from git metadata and prompt hashes; no model, no repo source, frozen prompts untouched

verification.command: tester V1-V5 at function level in clone/archive kits; pipeline_run, pipeline_pool, pipeline_track full fake-claude runs
verification.result: V1 pl_new_run wrote toolkit.json with a 40-hex commit, history card rev_src stamped; V2 result .toolkit.commit 40-hex, stamp off gives no key; V3 result JSON byte-equal minus .toolkit, run.json equal; V4 no-.git kit rc 0, commit null; V5 prompts diff 0 lines. Entry scripts not run by the tester (guard); conclusion and coverage_check covered by the full fake-claude runs in pipeline_run/pipeline_track (step_conclude runs coverage_check --conclusion) and by grep: only pipeline_lib.sh and history.py touch toolkit.json
